_meta.authority: NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Deterministic structuring of controlled current-state evidence; not a qualification decision and not an authorization. No facts are generated from absence.

reconciliation_points.name: Curling I/O
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: The House is master-data authority for club, affiliation, and participant records; competition/league standing never overrides governed master data.

reconciliation_points.name: Current registration provider (incumbent)
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Authoritative for legacy data only during transition; authority expires on an explicit recorded migration-completion (cutover) trigger.

reconciliation_points.name: Payment processors
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Governed decision to charge, fee policy, and resulting record remain in The House; explicit reconciliation boundary with accounting (SYS-008).

reconciliation_points.name: Sideline Learning
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the underlying record

reconciliation_points.name: Accreditation platforms
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the record

reconciliation_points.name: Document360
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Substitutable without changing governed truth

reconciliation_points.name: Analytics platforms
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Consumes projected data only; MUST NOT become a system of record

reconciliation_points.name: Accounting systems
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: The House synchronizes and does not overwrite the ledger; explicit boundary with payment processors (SYS-003).

reconciliation_points.name: Support systems (Halo / Zendesk where relevant)
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Support cases reference but do not own governed records

reconciliation_points.name: Identity and Microsoft 365 services
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Email/shared-file processes are manual controls, not governed systems of record; risk of shadow authority.

reconciliation_points.name: Manual spreadsheets and shared files

reconciliation_points.name: Email-mediated processes
reconciliation_points.reconciliation: Decisions and evidence live outside a governed store; audit and evidence binding are weak.
